messages.subject: ggplot2 loading failure
parts:
There has been no problem with RStudio and ggplot2 so far.

ggplot2 won't load with the following error message.

sh: otool: command not found
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'tcltk', details:
  call: system2("otool", c("-L", shQuote(DLL)), stdout = TRUE)

I am not familiar with this error message. 

Please leave any advice to resolve this issue ASAP.


Best,
Seongjin
